name: DANCING ON OUR GRAVES by DARKSTORE
description: Darkstore brings THE Goth & Alternative Party to VOID CLUB. Four events per year, four different Berlin clubs, constantly changing DJs & genres. The 2026 edition features Electric Visionary (K3LLR BERLIN) playing Horror Disco, Darkwave, Synthwave, EBM, and L CAPITAN (GOTHIC POGO LEIPZIG) playing Postpunk, Deathrock, Dark Wave, Cold Wave, Synth Wave, Horrorpunk. Doors open at 22:30. This is a LGBTQIA+ safe(r) space where discrimination, harassment, or hate will not be tolerated.
